title: Screen T740 idle-axis assignments and audit same-centre stars
body:
PR #3196 merged the paired-transfer audit. This follow-up extends that source-bound package with the complete eligible single-axis census, an optional OR-Tools assignment search over the same four rank-48 children, and an exact replay of a source-pinned PR #3184 star.

The registered exact replay authenticates PR3148's T740 fill and tests all 112 port recipes for owner replica zero. All 21,504 eligible single-axis moves and all 5,376 paired moves change the exact eight-stream Gaussian-integer operator at the relevant Fourier character.

The retained PR #3184 artifact (head `6faefe1`) sends axes `[16,32,64]` from child 10 to 12 and `[128,256,4096]` from child 10 to 13 for replica 0 / port 0. At each of the six moved-axis characters, the complete star overlay equals the corresponding isolated one-axis overlay and differs from the baseline operator. At character 16, the exact matrices differ in three entries.

This gives a scoped isolation result for same-centre stars on the audited owner-replica-zero recipes: a star takes distinct axes from one orthonormal donor basis, so at the character of any moved axis all other moved phases are inactive. Every one-axis move admitted by the complete census fails at its own character. This does not cover multi-donor cycles with nonorthogonal axes, other child/time pairs, or nonzero replicas.

The optional CP-SAT model preserves the 192 residual-axis tokens, fixed hosted axes and pairwise orthogonality, with a rank cap of 51. All 112 port models solve to optimality for the local moment surrogate and minimum move count. Each finds profile `[51,51,51,39]` from `[48,48,48,48]` with 12 moved tokens. The four-term surrogate changes by about `-1.026e-5` relative, but every minimum-move representative fails exact replay on its first tested character (1, 2 or 32). This is one representative per port, not an exhaustive check of assignments at that profile.

Reproduce the registered source-bound replay:

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/idle-star-paired-axis-census
```

The optional discovery artifact was generated with Python 3.10.12 and OR-Tools 9.11.4210:

```sh
python3.10 -B research/idle-star-paired-axis-census/ortools_screen.py > research/idle-star-paired-axis-census/ORTOOLS-RESULT.json
```

This is a scoped negative result. It claims no new κ, supplier admission or selected-frontier change. The port-0 replay rejects the exact-operator premise for the pinned PR #3184 star, without making a claim about that PR's other candidates or broader argument. PR #1252's earlier commuting exchange and the T740 physical objection in PR #3187 are credited in the package.
